_readme: SONORA Radio feed — updated by the Telegram bot or by hand.
tracks: ordered list of track ids that exist in audio/manifest.json (or demo ids).
messages: optional on-air text lines (from channel posts) shown as a live ticker.
streamUrl: optional external HLS/Icecast URL if you host a real stream elsewhere (leave empty on pure GitHub Pages).
Keep this file small. Do not embed binary audio here.

messages.t: Welcome to SONORA Live — tracks arrive from the channel.
